schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE accounts (
    id INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    balance NUMERIC(15,2) CHECK (balance >= 0),
    parent_id INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES accounts(id)
);

query: SELECT a1.name AS parent_name, a2.name AS child_name, a2.balance FROM accounts a1 JOIN accounts a2 ON a1.id = a2.parent_id WHERE a2.balance > 100 AND a1.balance > 500;
